description: This file contains unit tests for the CatalogItemService class in the BlazorAdmin project. It includes fake implementations for dependencies such as HTTP handlers and lookup services, and tests the constructor and list retrieval functionality of CatalogItemService using mocked HTTP responses.

classes.name: CatalogItemService_Smoke
classes.description: Contains unit tests for CatalogItemService, including setup and testing of HTTP interactions.

classes.name: NoopLogger<T>
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of ILogger<T> that does nothing, used for testing.

classes.name: NullDisposable
classes.description: A singleton disposable that performs no action when disposed.

classes.name: FakeLookupService<T>
classes.description: A fake implementation of ICatalogLookupDataService<T> that returns an empty list.

classes.name: FakeHttpMessageHandler
classes.description: A fake HTTP message handler used to mock HTTP responses during testing.

methods.name: CatalogItemService_Construct_Succeeds
methods.description: Tests that constructing CatalogItemService with mocked dependencies succeeds.

methods.name: CatalogItemService_List_UsesMockedHttpClient_ReturnsItems
methods.description: Tests that the List method of CatalogItemService correctly retrieves and parses catalog items using a mocked HTTP client.
